title: TotemGuard
description: TotemGuard is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 that blocks non-totem items from being placed in your offhand slot, with optional sound and chat notification. Includes item highlighting and an in-game GUI.
body:
TotemGuard is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 that helps you manage your offhand slot and never accidentally place the wrong item there.

## Features

### Totem Lock
Blocks any non-totem item from being placed in your offhand slot. If you try to put something other than a Totem of Undying in your offhand, it will automatically be moved back to your inventory. You can also enable a sound alert and a chat notification whenever this happens, so you always know when the lock is active.

### Item Highlighting
Highlight any item of your choice on your hotbar and offhand with a fully customizable color. This makes it easy to spot important items at a glance during intense gameplay. You can add multiple items to highlight at the same time, each with its own color.

### In-game GUI
All features can be toggled on and off instantly through an easy-to-use in-game GUI, opened by pressing the R key. No need to restart the game or edit config files.

### Language Support
The mod fully supports English and Polish. The language is automatically selected based on your Minecraft language settings.

## Notes
- Client-side only, works on any server
- Supports both left and right main hand settings
- Designed for PvP and survival players who rely on their Totem of Undying
